verdict.rationale: Milvus's own docs and llms.txt describe it as an open-source vector database, and its source is hosted publicly on GitHub at milvus-io/milvus, so users can read the code. missing for 10: the specific license (e.g. its name or terms) is not stated in the evidence, and there is no independent corroboration of the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Milvus is an open-source vector database that suits AI applications of every size
Milvus is an open-source, high-performance vector database designed for similarity search and AI application
